name: Nature's Call

angles.text: As a night elf, the Gnarlpine's fall from longtime companions into hostility and madness is a personal tragedy for Teldrassil's defenders.
As a druid, you are attuned to nature's balance and the spiritual corruption affecting Kalimdor's creatures. Nightmare-touched furbolg totems are cause for alarm.
As an Alliance member, you help protect Teldrassil's boughs and keep your newfound night elf allies anchored on Kalimdor.

faq.answer: Tarindrella, a dryad, watches over Shadowglen in Teldrassil. Alarmed by the Gnarlpine furbolgs' sudden hostility, she asks you to recover relics from their camps and seek the cause of their madness.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Nature's Call?

faq.answer: The Gnarlpine furbolgs suffered nightmares of a looming shadow that threatened to destroy them. Dread twisted into paranoia and fury, until they saw their longtime night elf allies as enemies.
faq.q: Why did the Gnarlpine furbolgs turn hostile?

faq.answer: Smaller Gnarlpine totems lie in abandoned furbolg camps along the glen's western edge. Grell and grellkin scavenging among the ruins have scattered some across the surrounding area.
faq.q: Where are the Gnarlpine totems located?

faq.answer: Tarindrella advises you to leave the larger totems in the camps. She says that, as a dryad, she would not know what to do with such cumbersome carvings, and prefers smaller engraved totems that can be carried.
faq.q: Why can't players collect the larger totems in the camps?

faq.answer: The Gnarlpine are a furbolg tribe native to Teldrassil. They lived peacefully alongside the night elves, but creeping nightmares have recently turned them into aggressive foes.

aliases: what is the shadow in teldrassil
faq.answer: The totems speak of an unseen Great Shadow haunting the furbolgs' dreams. Its origin remains unknown, and Tarindrella hopes their fate will help uncover the broader corruption afflicting Teldrassil.
faq.q: What is the great shadow mentioned in the totems?

sections.body: The dryad Tarindrella asks you to search camps along Shadowglen's western border. The Gnarlpine furbolgs left them in haste, and she cannot believe they would cast aside centuries of friendship with the night elves without cause. Bring back intact engraved totems. Their carvings may tell what changed.
sections.title: Investigating the Glen

sections.body: The Gnarlpine totems tell of nightmares about an encroaching shadow that would wipe out their tribe. Fear grew into blind rage and warped their minds. They came to see their longtime elven neighbors as the very shadow they feared. Tarindrella hopes their story will shed light on the deeper malaise creeping through Teldrassil.
sections.title: The Shadow and the Nightmare

summary: In Shadowglen, Tarindrella seeks the cause of the Gnarlpine's sudden hostility. Their carved totems may tell why they turned against their longtime night elf allies.
